GenerationCanvasBridge: isolated child canvas execution
|-- AgentChatService calls add/history/remove to control child lifetime
|   |-- add(): documentFromHistory() -> MappingDocumentController
|   |   `-- New contextId; initial version 0; no browser selection change
|   `-- contexts entry owns documentId, controller, persist, receipts and queue
|-- dispatch(): select managed entry by canvasId
|   |-- Require matching documentId; serialize commands through entry.queue
|   |-- Missing generation canvas fails as inactive
|   `-- Other targets delegate to live CanvasSessionBridge
|       `-- Parent capture and synchronization still use a live browser
|-- Reads: identity / context / document-state / read / snapshot
|   |-- currentCanvasRead() supplies small/full read projection
|   `-- snapshot can export requested/current revisions with dependencies
|-- Mutations: requestId + command signature -> retained receipt
|   |-- Changed signature for same method/requestId -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |-- First execution: controller.applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|   |   |-- Revision/batch edits also carry expectedRevisionId
|   |   |-- Convert supplied revisions/variants and generated creations
|   |   `-- Report unresolvedEdgeIds after revision/batch application
|   |-- Cache result before persist(controller.exportHistory(true))
|   |   `-- Identical retry reuses result and retries history persistence
|   `-- Resolve only after persist succeeds; queue recovers after rejection
`-- Limited child view/checkpoint surface
    |-- canvas-view list returns empty saved views; save acknowledges state
    |-- checkpoint requires expectedVersion and returns canvasRevisionId
    `-- Other fork management stays with the parent canvas
